physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African foundation (56.8%) with significant Central Asian (19.2%) influence creating distinctive bone structure. Additional ancestry from East Asian (8.2%), Southeast Asian (6.6%), Hispanic/Latin American (5.1%), and North African (4.1%) heritage creates a complex phenotype: deep warm brown skin with golden and subtle warm undertones, high prominent cheekbones with Central Asian angularity, refined jawline structure, and eye geometry showing gentle East Asian influence with wider-set placement and subtle epicanthal character. A truly global genetic mosaic.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with minimal body fat; wiry musculature from years of precise manual work and nervous energy. Chest and shoulders slightly narrow, giving an ascetic appearance.
physical_description.hair_style: Cleanly shaved scalp, maintained with regular precision; no facial hair.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, with faint neural-interface lag when he's processing encrypted data (pupils dilate irregularly).
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones from Sub-Saharan heritage, enriched by subtle Central Asian warmth and North African influence. Rich saturation that catches light with a luminous quality; the skin has a healthy, almost polished appearance despite chronic stress.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones characteristic of Sub-Saharan ancestry with generous facial width, refined by Central Asian structural angularity. Strong, defined jawline enhanced by the bone structure inheritance. Eye geometry reflects East Asian heritageâ€”wider-set with gentle epicanthal foldâ€”balanced against the broader Sub-Saharan facial proportions. Skin is clear but shows chronic sleep deprivation with faint purple undertones beneath eyes. Lips are full and well-defined, often pressed in concentration. Facial structure shows harmonious blending across all ancestry components.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware pattern running along the left and right jawline in faint blue-green, brightest at the angles of the jaw and fading down the collarboneâ€”dormant in daylight but visible in dim environments as a soft pulse that speeds when he's anxious.
Thin surgical scar running from the base of his right index finger to mid-knuckle, where the retractable claw mechanism was installed; scar tissue is pale and slightly raised.
Small burn mark on his left forearm (3cm diameter), circular and oldâ€”from a fumbled soldering iron during an early geneware self-modification attempt, now faded to off-white against his skin.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The retractable claw on his right index finger is visible when extended (surgical-grade titanium alloy with mono-molecular edge, housed beneath a synthetic nail cap). The bioluminescent jaw pattern glows softly in darknessâ€”currently his most visible augmentation, though he downplays it. The neural-haptic overlay is subcutaneous and invisible, but his right hand occasionally twitches with micro-adjustments when he's thinking through a procedure.
physical_description.posture_movement: He moves with careful, economical precisionâ€”a consequence of both his surgical work and his anxiety. His gait is quick and slightly forward-leaning, as if always moving toward something just out of reach. He has a habit of clenching and unclenching his right fist, and his fingers often trace the air in practiced surgical patterns when he's talking. His neck is slightly tense, shoulders high. He maintains eye contact longer than comfortable, as if trying to convince whoever he's talking to of his sincerity.
physical_description.clothing_style: Wears a forged Ferrogate Transit worker vest (charcoal grey with reflective piping, slightly worn at the cuffs) over a plain black merino wool undershirt. The ID badge clipped to his vest reads 'ORLAN D. â€” PLATFORM MAINTENANCE 7B' with a falsified corporately-issued laminate. Cargo pants in dark olive, pre-worn, with heavy-duty pockets suitable for carrying sealed medical containers. Steel-toed boots (scuffed, well-maintained). Over this, he wears a lightweight insulated jacket in slate greyâ€”practical for the cold-storage unit and the transit platform's climate control. No visible jewelry or personal markers beyond the geneware. His aesthetic is deliberately forgettable: Tier 3-4 worker, unremarkable, designed to pass through checkpoints without drawing attention.
